critical_questions.topic: Capital adequacy, dividend sustainability, and organic capital generation
critical_questions.why_critical: Probes whether organic capital generation is sufficient to support dividends and maintain CET1 at 11% without further external measures. Material to shareholder returns and capital resilience in a deteriorating credit cycle.
critical_questions.question_summary: Given declining organic capital generation, rising DTA, and lower profitability, at what CET1 level would management reconsider dividends? Are there other capital relief measures being considered?
critical_questions.management_response_summary: Geovanne Tobias stated that management maintains a 30% minimum dividend payout and expects organic capital generation to support both dividends and the 11% CET1 target. He noted that 2Q onwards net income is expected to improve to R$5-6bn per quarter. Management indicated a list of contingency measures exists but is not expected to be needed in 2026.
